mapper.update: UPDATE fire_119_incident SET street_name=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_name ELSE CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.street_name} ELSE street_name END END, street_match_status=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_status ELSE CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.street_match_status} ELSE street_match_status END END, street_match_basis=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_basis ELSE CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.street_match_basis} ELSE street_match_basis END END, street_match_method=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_method ELSE CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.street_match_method} ELSE street_match_method END END, map_longitude=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.map_longitude} ELSE map_longitude END, map_latitude=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.map_latitude} ELSE map_latitude END, source_coord_system=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.source_coord_system} ELSE source_coord_system END, coordinate_status=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.coordinate_status} ELSE coordinate_status END, last_seen_at=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.now} ELSE last_seen_at END, last_sync_batch_id=CASE incident_id WHEN #{r.incident_id} THEN #{r.batch} ELSE last_sync_batch_id END WHERE source_system=#{source} AND (incident_id=#{r.incident_id} AND payload_hash=#{r.payload_hash})

UPDATE fire_119_incident SET order_source=#{order_source}, region_code=#{region_code}, case_type_code=#{case_type_code}, case_type_name=#{case_type_name}, case_status_code=#{case_status_code}, case_status_name=#{case_status_name}, alarm_time=#{alarm_time}, address=#{address}, description=#{description}, case_nature_code=#{case_nature_code}, case_nature_name=#{case_nature_name}, merge_status_code=#{merge_status_code}, merge_status_name=#{merge_status_name}, case_level_code=#{case_level_code}, case_level_name=#{case_level_name}, source_longitude=#{source_longitude}, source_latitude=#{source_latitude}, source_coord_system=#{source_coord_system}, map_longitude=#{map_longitude}, map_latitude=#{map_latitude}, coordinate_status=#{coordinate_status}, source_sjc=#{source_sjc}, source_create_time_utc=#{source_create_time_utc}, source_njs_create_time_utc=#{source_njs_create_time_utc}, source_njs_update_time_utc=#{source_njs_update_time_utc}, source_sugon_create_time_utc=#{source_sugon_create_time_utc}, source_sugon_update_time_utc=#{source_sugon_update_time_utc}, source_manually_add=#{source_manually_add}, source_counterfeit=#{source_counterfeit}, source_flag=#{source_flag}, source_manual_operate_count=#{source_manual_operate_count}, raw_json=#{raw_json}, payload_hash=#{payload_hash}, street_name=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_name ELSE #{street_name} END, street_match_status=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_status ELSE #{street_match_status} END, street_match_basis=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_basis ELSE #{street_match_basis} END, street_match_method=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_method ELSE #{street_match_method} END, revision_no=#{revision_no},last_seen_at=#{now},last_changed_at=#{now},last_sync_batch_id=#{batch},update_by='119-sync',update_time=#{now} WHERE incident_id=#{incident_id}

UPDATE fire_119_incident SET street_name=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_name ELSE #{street_name} END, street_match_status=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_status ELSE #{street_match_status} END, street_match_basis=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_basis ELSE #{street_match_basis} END, street_match_method=CASE WHEN street_match_method='manual' THEN street_match_method ELSE #{street_match_method} END,map_longitude=#{map_longitude},map_latitude=#{map_latitude},source_coord_system=#{source_coord_system},coordinate_status=#{coordinate_status},last_seen_at=#{now},last_sync_batch_id=#{batch} WHERE incident_id=#{incident_id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fire_119_sync_state(source_system,query_region_code,last_quick_attempt_at,last_quick_completed_at,last_quick_result,last_quick_error,last_quick_failures,last_new_incident_at) VALUES(#{source},#{region},#{started},#{completed},#{result},#{error},#{failures},#{discovered}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_quick_attempt_at=VALUES(last_quick_attempt_at),last_quick_completed_at=COALESCE(VALUES(last_quick_completed_at),last_quick_completed_at),last_quick_result=VALUES(last_quick_result),last_quick_error=VALUES(last_quick_error), last_quick_failures=CASE WHEN VALUES(last_quick_result)='success' THEN 0 WHEN VALUES(last_quick_result)='running' THEN last_quick_failures ELSE last_quick_failures+1 END, last_new_incident_at=COALESCE(VALUES(last_new_incident_at),last_new_incident_at),update_time=#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT last_attempt_at AS lastAttemptAt,last_completed_at AS lastCompletedAt,last_result AS lastResult,consecutive_failures AS consecutiveFailures, last_quick_attempt_at AS lastQuickAttemptAt,last_quick_completed_at AS lastQuickCompletedAt,last_quick_result AS lastQuickResult, last_quick_failures AS lastQuickFailures,last_new_incident_at AS lastNewIncidentAt FROM fire_119_sync_state WHERE source_system=#{source} AND query_region_code=#{region}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(a.street_match_status='inside'),0) AS insideCount,COALESCE(SUM(a.street_match_status='pending'),0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(a.street_match_status='outside'),0) AS outsideCount, MAX(a.last_seen_at) AS latestReceivedAt,MAX(a.alarm_time) AS latestAlarmTime FROM fire_119_incident a WHERE a.source_system=#{params.sourceSystem} ${params.dataScope}
